svg.title: FastRider · asymmetric live cells and full distance precision · v0.3.15
svg.desc: 246x322 Edge840. Dividers x112. Left column gear/grade, right wider column rpm/mph. Grade integer, speed one decimal. Heart only and bolt + seconds align with the visible primary numeral left edges. Synthetic long-distance example; native screenshots are authoritative for font rendering.
